info.title: ZaMove API
info.summary: Transportation and logistics booking platform for Zambia
info.description:
Contract-first description of the ZaMove REST API (Labs 4 and 5, ICT461).

* All endpoints are served over **HTTPS (TLS 1.3)** only.
* Request bodies are JSON and are validated against the schemas in `components/schemas` (JSON Schema 2020-12, `additionalProperties: false`) before any business logic runs.
* Every error is an RFC 7807 `application/problem+json` document.
* Authentication is a server-side session identified by an `HttpOnly; Secure; SameSite=Strict` cookie.
* Every response carries `RateLimit-*` headers; breaching a limit returns **429**.

servers.description: Local XAMPP over HTTPS (replaced automatically with the real host when served by the API)

tags.name: Users
tags.description: Account registration and the signed-in profile

tags.name: Sessions
tags.description: Login and logout (server-side sessions, cookie transport)

post.summary: Register a customer or operator account
post.description: Creates an account. `role` can only be `customer` or `operator`; `admin` accounts are never created through the API. Operators start as `pending` until an administrator approves them.

post.summary: Log in and start a session
post.description: Verifies the credentials and, on success, creates a server-side session and returns its identifier **only** in a `Set-Cookie` header (`HttpOnly`, `Secure`, `SameSite=Strict`). The identifier is never present in the JSON body.

delete.description: Deletes the session record on the server and expires the cookie in the browser. Replaying the old cookie afterwards returns 401.

get.description: Only parameters declared below are accepted; any other query parameter is rejected with 400.

post.summary: Reserve seats on a schedule (one ACID transaction)
post.description: Locks the schedule, takes the seats, creates the booking, the passenger details, a pending payment and the status history in ONE database transaction (`BEGIN` ... `COMMIT`). If any step fails the whole transaction is rolled back, so there is never a half-made booking and seats are never lost or oversold. The price is calculated on the server from the schedule's fare; the client cannot send an amount.

404.description: The schedule does not exist or is not open for booking

409.description: Not enough seats left (nothing was changed)

get.summary: Read one booking (customer: own; operator: own company; admin: any)
get.description: Object-level access control (OWASP A01). A booking that does not exist and a booking the caller may not see both answer 404, so ids cannot be enumerated.

get.summary: Search upcoming departures between two towns
get.description: Public, paginated search over routes and schedules. Every filter is a bound query parameter (no string concatenation). Only parameters declared below are accepted.

200.description: A page of departures, soonest first

post.summary: Operator opens a departure on one of its routes and vehicles

get.summary: My company's departures with seats left

Pay for a held booking (DEMONSTRATION gateway)

sessionCookie.name: __Host-zamove_sid
sessionCookie.description: Opaque 256-bit session identifier issued by POST /sessions. The browser stores and sends it automatically; JavaScript cannot read it (HttpOnly).

RateLimit-Limit.description: Requests allowed in the current window

RateLimit-Remaining.description: Requests left in the current window

Retry-After.description: Seconds to wait before retrying (sent with 429)

Set-Cookie.description: `__Host-zamove_sid=<64 hex>; expires=...; Max-Age=...; path=/; secure; HttpOnly; SameSite=Strict`

Set-Cookie-Expired.description: Same cookie with an expiry date in the past (instructs the browser to delete it)
